messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft slotting and guest briefs for Evergreen workshop

Hi Marcus / Mina,

Attaching the working draft of the agenda for the Evergreen two-day executive workshop (attachments: guest-briefs_Evergreen_v1.docx). Key asks below — goal is to ship a locked agenda + speaker briefs to Evergreen and venue ops by EOD Thu so they can do final travel confirmations.

Quick context: Evergreen requested a tighter 45-min executive slot on day one (C-suite offsite) and a 90-min break-out on day two for ops deep-dive. We also have a VIP arrival (Dr. Ramos) who needs a 20-min private briefing pre-session.

Please:
- Marcus: review slot owners and suggest any content swaps (I highlighted three sessions that could move to day two).
- Mina: pull final slide pack owners and confirm who will bring live demos (I flagged two demos that currently clash with travel windows).
- Both: review the guest brief template (last tab) — I tried to keep it one page per attendee with 3x talking points.

Constraints to keep in mind:
- Venue load-in window is 07:00–09:30 on day one. AV can’t accept drops after 09:45.
- Evergreen requested no group lunches on day one (they want networking tables and staggered meals).

Attachments: guest-briefs_Evergreen_v1.docx (guest-by-seat, bios), speaker-briefer_v3.docx (template).

I’ll collate edits on Wed and push version for external review Thu morning. Flag anything that would cause a presenter conflict.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft slotting and guest briefs for Evergreen workshop

Vanessa — thanks for the draft, this looks solid. A few inline notes and a suggested reshuffle below. I’m attaching a quick CSV export of speaker availability times I pulled from the sheet.

Edits/suggestions (high level):
- Move the "Platform economics" 60-min slot from day one afternoon -> day two morning (frees up the C-suite window for a tighter executive discussion).
- Swap the two live demos so the heavier latency demo is immediately after lunch (teams will have better connectivity in the room and fewer overlapping sessions).
- Add a 20-min "VIP pre-brief" slot 30 minutes before day one kickoff for Dr. Ramos (put on my calendar, I can run it with product).

Speaker responsibilities: I confirmed with Priya and Jonas; Priya will take the ops deep-dive, Jonas will handle partner integration. I left margin notes on who needs a 1-pager brief (marked with "BRIEF-1P").

Attachments: evergreen-speaker-availability.csv (inline), suggested-agenda-changes.xlsx (I used comments).

On the guest briefs: I shortened the bios to 2–3 lines and pulled out company-specific ask bullets — this should make the one-pager more digestible for execs.

If you want, I can send this as a tracked-change doc to Evergreen tomorrow AM.
